seo_title: Cost of Living in Podgorica 2026: Visa, Prices, Reviews | Relocost
seo_description: How much does it cost to live in Podgorica per month, do Russians need a visa, work, rent and reviews from those who relocated. A realistic moving budget in the Relocost calculator.
intro_text: Visa-free entry for 30 days with the option to extend, and an accessible path to residency through business or property. A quiet capital for those who want to live in a country on track for the EU.
pros: Visa-free entry for 30 days, with a simple path to residency
The euro — a stable currency with no volatility
Access to all of Montenegro — from the sea to the mountains in 1–2 hours
Proximity to the EU and Montenegro's candidate status
A calm pace of life and a low crime rate
cons: Hot, dry summers in the basin — up to +40°C in July
A weak job market — most relocators work remotely
A serious shortage of quality private healthcare
A limited choice of international schools

visa_steps.title: Visa-free entry
visa_steps.description: Up to 30 days without a visa, extendable for another 30 days through the police or a trip to Serbia.

visa_steps.title: Registration (Beli karton)
visa_steps.description: Within 24 hours of moving in — registration with the police via your landlord.

visa_steps.title: Residency through work or business
visa_steps.description: Opening a company (DOO) or a contract with a local employer — a path to a 1-year residency.

visa_steps.title: Buying property
visa_steps.description: Residency through housing of any value — the most popular path for Russians.

visa_steps.title: Account and taxes
visa_steps.description: CKB, NLB, Erste — they work with Russians. The tax for sole traders is 9–15%.

faq.question: Is Podgorica in the EU?
faq.answer: No, but it has had candidate status since 2010, the euro is the official currency, and the Schengen area is nearby.

faq.question: Which language is spoken in Podgorica?
faq.answer: Montenegrin (close to Serbian); in the tourism sector people speak English and Russian.

faq.question: Is the sea far from Podgorica?
faq.answer: 1 hour to Budva or Bar, 1.5 to Kotor. Many live in Podgorica and head to the sea on weekends.

faq.question: Can I work for Western companies in Podgorica?
faq.answer: Yes, through a DOO (LLC) or freelancing — 9% tax, contracts in euros.

faq.question: What is healthcare like in Podgorica?
faq.answer: Public care is weak, but Podgorica has private clinics. Many treat complex cases in Serbia or the EU.

faq.question: What is the climate like in Podgorica?
faq.answer: Mediterranean: +5°C in winter, +30–40°C in summer in the basin, with little rainfall.

reviews.text: I opened a DOO and pay 9% tax in euros. Housing in Podgorica costs €600, and weekends are by the sea. The downside — in summer the city is stifling, saved only by the AC and Skadar Lake.
This isn't Europe in the full sense, but everything you need is here: banks, schools, restaurants. My daughter goes to an international school and my husband works remotely.
